short: Unitary Hida families from the printed Hida hypotheses

lean.name: UpperTheory.V.Hi.hida_unitary_of_printed_hida
lean.plain: Unitary Hida families from the printed Hida hypotheses
lean.note: Under the cited Hida hypotheses, the proof constructs an ideal of the universal ordinary determinant ring for the unitary group. The resulting quotient has dense arithmetic points satisfying the required purity and classicality conditions, and the construction supplies automorphy.
